positions.commentary: The speaker describes Procter & Gamble as a fantastic company that is well-structured and does everything its own way, noting that this approach works.
The speaker compares the company to an Uber for IT and technical consultants, highlighting its large database of roughly 12,000 consultants.
The speaker states that Sagax has been one of the most successful real estate businesses in Sweden and is ranked 10th globally among stocklisted companies for returns.
The speaker mentions that Vtec is ranked 12th globally among stocklisted companies for returns over the last 15 years, noting it is another Swedish company on the list.
The speaker mentions that Sagax has an investment grade rating since 2018, which allowed them to secure fixed rates on their bonds.

thesis: This episode argues that specific companies like Procter & Gamble and Vtec (INTU) are excellent, well-structured businesses with strong historical returns, while also highlighting the success of Swedish real estate firm Sagax (BKRB) and its investment-grade status. The discussion further identifies a niche opportunity in the IT consulting space comparable to Uber.
